headline: Xcode 27.3 beta adds GitHub Copilot integration to coding assistant
summary: Apple's latest beta for its developer tool integrates the popular AI coding assistant, enhancing code completion and generation.
details: Apple has released Xcode 27.3 beta 1, bringing significant updates for developers. The most notable change is the integration of GitHub Copilot into Xcode's built-in coding assistant.

This new feature aims to enhance the development workflow by providing AI-powered code suggestions and completions directly within the IDE. Developers can now leverage Copilot's capabilities without needing to switch between applications.

The beta version also includes other improvements and bug fixes, as Apple continues to refine its development tools. This move signals Apple's increasing embrace of AI technologies to assist developers.

Xcode is Apple's integrated development environment (IDE) used for developing software for macOS, iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and watchOS. The integration of Copilot is expected to boost productivity for developers working on the Apple ecosystem.
caption:
Xcode 27.3 beta 1 is here, and it brings GitHub Copilot directly into Apple's developer tool.

Apple has released Xcode 27.3 beta 1, bringing significant updates for developers. The most notable change is the integration of GitHub Copilot into Xcode's built-in coding assistant.

This new feature aims to enhance the development workflow by providing AI-powered code suggestions and completions directly within the IDE. Developers can now leverage Copilot's capabilities without needing to switch between applications.

The beta version also includes other improvements and bug fixes, as Apple continues to refine its development tools. This move signals Apple's increasing embrace of AI technologies to assist developers.

Xcode is Apple's integrated development environment (IDE) used for developing software for macOS, iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and watchOS. The integration of Copilot is expected to boost productivity for developers working on the Apple ecosystem.
